sources.locator: Product List table RK10J11E0034 row on physical page 1; Drawing No.1 circuit and mounting-hole figures on physical page 2
sources.evidence_extract: Exact single-unit RK10J11E0034: 10 kOhm, 1B taper, +/-30% total resistance, manual soldering, catalog notation Insertion (t: 2 mm), 20 V DC maximum. Black integral knob diameter 14 mm, thickness 0.9 mm; Drawing No.1 shows end terminals 1 and 3 and wiper 2, with two dummy lower positions. Operating life 10,000 cycles, ambient -10 to +60 C. This outline catalog asks users to obtain formal supply specifications.

sources.locator: Mechanical Performance table: Total rotational angle and Stopper strength rows; Basic information resistance and taper rows
sources.evidence_extract: Exact RK10J11E0034: total rotational angle 270 degrees +/-10 degrees, stopper strength 70 mN m; physical stops. Single-unit 10 kOhm, 1B taper. Stopper strength is not permission to force the stops.

sources.locator: COMPONENTS table RV1/SW2/R22/R27/C22; NETS BRIGHT_WIPER/BRIGHT_ADC/V15/V15_FUSED; NO_CONNECT
sources.evidence_extract: RV1.1=GND, RV1.3=V3P3, RV1.2=BRIGHT_WIPER through R27 100 Ohm to BRIGHT_ADC=U3.7 PA0; C22 100 nF and R22 100 kOhm connect BRIGHT_ADC to GND. U3.8 is unused; RV1 MP1-MP4 are mechanical no-connects. R23/R28/C23 and SW1 removed. Firmware is a documented target, not flashed behavior.

sources.locator: Component identity table; stock and available order quantity rows; Assembly Type and PCBA Type rows
sources.evidence_extract: Observed 2026-09-06 JST: Alps Alpine RK10J11E0034 C470643, stock 6939 and available order quantity 6677; live UI confirms Wave Soldering and Economic/Standard PCBA. Stock is not reserved. The ALPS catalog lists Manual soldering for this exact orderable, so confirm the permitted assembly process with JLCPCB before fabrication. Neither the listing nor the imported model certifies seating in the project 1.6 mm board.
